Clients and the wider team
- Liaising with clients, expert witnesses, patent and trade mark attorneys, and third parties.
- Contributing to business development activity.

- Exposure to expert evidence or technically complex cases.

The person

You are proactive, solution-focused and comfortable taking ownership of your own work, but equally at home as part of a close team. You have commercial awareness, a genuine interest in IP and ambitions to keep progressing in disputes work.
